Can't wait for @JoshTBoswell to start.


Josh Boswell (@JoshTBoswell)

I’m joining @CBSNews investigations team!

I’ll be an Investigative Reporter-Producer. That means some work on-camera, some behind it.

I’ve had a great time at @Daily_MailUS, and was proud to serve there as Chief Investigative Reporter.

I start the new gig Monday. So if you’ve got a story, let me know🕵🏻‍♂️

deadline.com/2026/06/cbs-new…

CBS News PR (@CBSNewsPress)

Trevor Phillips (@TrevorPTweets) is one of the sharpest and most fearless journalists anywhere in the world. We’re thrilled to have him join @CBSNews as senior global affairs correspondent

Nick Bilton is one of the most entrepreneurial and ambitious journalists working today. I am thrilled that he is the next executive producer of 60 Minutes. His note here:


Nick Bilton (@nickbilton)

It's the honor of my career to become the executive producer of 60 Minutes. I just shared the note below with the incredible staff and can't wait to get started.
